workflow.workflow_md_content:
# Aurora Multi-Plant Deviation, CAPA & Recall Orchestration

## Main Flow

| Step | Actor | Action | BR | Gateway |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| S1 | ACT-QA | Intake deviation bind lot and plant | BR-01 | |
| S2 | ACT-QA | Set severity Critical, Major, or Minor | BR-02 | XOR |
| S3a | ACT-WH | Place inventory hold (Critical/Major); segregate held vs sellable stock | BR-06, BR-14 | |
| S3b | ACT-QA | Skip hold when Minor | | |
| S4 | ACT-LAB | Lab investigation track | BR-04 | AND |
| S5 | ACT-PROD | Production investigation track | BR-04 | AND |
| S6 | ACT-QA | Join tracks; check evidence complete. If missing lab/timeline, block CAPA close | BR-05, BR-11 | |
| S7 | ACT-QA | Escalate to Critical if adulteration risk detected | BR-13 | |
| S8 | ACT-REG | Review Critical case before market action | BR-08 | |
| S9 | ACT-REG | Propose recall class (None, Class Two, Class One) | BR-09 | XOR |
| S10a | ACT-QA | Close with Class None after CAPA effectiveness review | BR-09 | |
| S10b | ACT-QA | Concur Class Two | BR-09 | |
| S10c | ACT-PM | Confirm Class One | BR-03, BR-09 | |
| S11 | ACT-LOG | Execute recall shipments (Class Two or Class One) | BR-10 | |
| S12 | ACT-QA | Release hold (requires ACT-QA signature; ACT-WH cannot release alone) | BR-07 | |
| S13 | ACT-PM | Acknowledge Critical severity before final CAPA close | BR-03 | |
| S14 | ACT-PO | Approve BA package | BR-12 | |

## Exception Flows

| Step | Actor | Action | BR | Gateway |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| E-01 | ACT-QA | Intake missing lot or plant identity — block creation, show error | BR-01 | |

## End States

- **Success**: BA Package Approved (S14), Recall Executed (S11), Hold Released (S12).
- **Blocked**: CAPA Closed due to missing evidence (S6), Recall Class None (S10a).
- **Escalated**: Severity escalated to Critical (S7), Critical requires PM Acknowledgment (S13).

## Notes
- **XOR**: Severity (S2), Recall Class (S9).
- **AND**: Dual Investigation Tracks (S4, S5).
- **Actors**: ACT-QA, ACT-PROD, ACT-LAB, ACT-WH, ACT-REG, ACT-PM, ACT-LOG, ACT-PO.
- **Scope**: Covers intake, severity, dual investigation, hold/release, recall decision/execution, and BA approval.
- **Exclusions**: No public press, ERP financial credits, new lab equipment, LMS training, external regulator API, LIMS replacement, or WMS UI redesign.

use_cases.statement: Là ACT-QA, tôi muốn intake deviation gắn batch lot và originating plant để bắt đầu CAPA.

acceptance_criteria.then: case ở stage Intake với severity chưa chốt
acceptance_criteria.given: lot identity và plant có mặt

acceptance_criteria.then: hệ thống hiển thị lỗi required field và dừng tạo case

use_cases.statement: Là ACT-LAB, tôi muốn chạy dual-track investigation song song với ACT-PROD để đủ evidence trước effectiveness review.

acceptance_criteria.then: case chuyển sang stage chờ effectiveness review
acceptance_criteria.given: cả hai track investigation (LAB và PROD) đã hoàn thành

acceptance_criteria.then: hệ thống hiển thị lỗi required evidence và dừng đóng case
acceptance_criteria.given: thiếu lab result hoặc missing production timeline

use_cases.statement: Là ACT-WH, tôi muốn place hold khi severity Critical hoặc Major và chỉ release khi ACT-QA ký để giữ lot Held/Quarantine tách biệt khỏi sellable stock.

acceptance_criteria.then: lot status Held/Quarantine segregated from sellable stock
hold release requires ACT-QA signature after CAPA close — ACT-WH alone cannot release
acceptance_criteria.given: ACT-WH cố release trước khi ACT-QA ký

use_cases.statement: Là ACT-REG, tôi muốn đề xuất recall class None/Class Two/Class One và giao ACT-LOG execute khi class khác None để kiểm soát market action.

acceptance_criteria.then: severity tự động escalate lên Critical trước khi xác định recall class
acceptance_criteria.given: adulteration risk được phát hiện trong investigation

acceptance_criteria.then: case chuyển sang trạng thái chờ ACT-LOG execute recall
case chuyển sang stage chờ ACT-LOG execute recall shipments
acceptance_criteria.given: ACT-REG đề xuất Class Two hoặc Class One

acceptance_criteria.then: case chuyển sang stage chờ ACT-QA close CAPA (không kích hoạt recall)

use_cases.statement: Là ACT-PROD, tôi muốn chạy production investigation track song song với ACT-LAB để đủ evidence trước CAPA effectiveness review.

acceptance_criteria.then: production investigation track complete before join

use_cases.statement: Là ACT-PM, tôi muốn acknowledge Critical và confirm Class One để đóng CAPA đúng gate.

acceptance_criteria.then: Class One confirmed before ACT-LOG execute

use_cases.statement: Là ACT-LOG, tôi muốn execute recall shipments sau khi Class Two hoặc Class One confirmed để rút hàng khỏi market.

acceptance_criteria.given: Class Two or Class One confirmed

acceptance_criteria.then: no recall shipments and case stays on CAPA close path

use_cases.statement: Là ACT-PO, tôi muốn approve BA package sau Validate để chốt scope Aurora.

steps.action: Intake deviation bind lot and plant
Set severity Critical, Major, or Minor
Place inventory hold (Critical/Major); segregate held vs sellable stock
Skip hold when Minor
Lab investigation track
Production investigation track
Join tracks; check evidence complete. If missing lab/timeline, block CAPA close
Escalate to Critical if adulteration risk detected
Review Critical case before market action
Propose recall class (None, Class Two, Class One)
Close with Class None after CAPA effectiveness review
Concur Class Two
Confirm Class One
Execute recall shipments (Class Two or Class One)
Release hold (requires ACT-QA signature; ACT-WH cannot release alone)
Acknowledge Critical severity before final CAPA close
Approve BA package

end_states: **Success**: BA Package Approved (S14), Recall Executed (S11), Hold Released (S12).
**Blocked**: CAPA Closed due to missing evidence (S6), Recall Class None (S10a).
**Escalated**: Severity escalated to Critical (S7), Critical requires PM Acknowledgment (S13).

exceptions.handling: Intake missing lot or plant identity — block creation, show error

business_rules.statement: Deviation case binds one batch lot identity and one originating plant.
Severity is Critical, Major, or Minor; only ACT-QA may set or change severity.
Critical severity requires ACT-PM acknowledgment before CAPA close.
CAPA starts two investigation tracks in parallel: ACT-LAB and ACT-PROD.
Both investigation tracks complete before CAPA effectiveness review.
ACT-WH places inventory hold when severity is Critical or Major.
Hold release requires ACT-QA signature; ACT-WH alone cannot release.
ACT-REG reviews every Critical case before market action.
Recall class is None, Class Two, or Class One; ACT-REG proposes; ACT-PM confirms Class One.
ACT-LOG executes recall shipments only after Class One or Class Two is confirmed.
Missing lab result or missing production timeline prevents CAPA close.
ACT-PO approves the BA package; agents never approve wiki pages.
When lab shows adulteration risk, severity escalates to Critical before recall class.
Held lots stay segregated; sellable stock stays separate from held lots.
